name: repro-light
steps: (async()=>{for(let i=0;i<200;i++){const el=document.querySelector('.app');if(el){let f=el[Object.keys(el).find(k=>k.startsWith('__reactFiber'))];for(;f;f=f.return){if(f.memoizedProps?.app){window.__v1app=f.memoizedProps.app;return;}}}await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100));}throw Error('App did not open');})()

(async()=>{const v=document.querySelector('.an-clip-review video');if(!v)throw Error('Reviewed video missing');v.muted=true;await v.play();for(let i=0;i<100&&v.currentTime<0.15;i++)await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,50));v.pause();if(v.currentTime<0.15||v.error)throw Error('Reviewed video did not play');v.currentTime=0;})()

(async()=>{window.__repro=await import('/src/dev/sim/repro.ts');const m=await import('/src/state/annotations.ts');const ds=m.annotationStore(window.__v1app.profile.profileId).get();const d=Object.values(ds).find(d=>d.marks.some(m=>m.label==='A'));if(!d||d.clipEdits.S1.start!=='2'||d.clipEdits.S1.end!=='5'||d.steps[0]?.text!=='Open the menu and watch it disappear')throw Error('Draft lost after reload');window.__reproId=d.id;await window.__repro.assertions(window.__v1app,d.id);window.__v1app.ui.selectTask(d.projectId,d.taskId);window.__v1app.ui.push({screen:"annotate",annotationId:d.id});})()
